text: **Blocking bug found and fixed while writing the acceptance test**: `cross_mint_publish.rs`'s retry dispatch derived its new `SendNutzap` journal operation id from the caller's `correlation_id` via `operation_id_for` — the *same* id the original (now-terminal) send used, so `begin_operation_at` hit `DuplicateOperation` on every real dispatch (production always supplies a correlation id) and silently dropped the retry with no error ever surfaced. Fixed by keying the retry off the mint-issued `target_quote_id` instead, plus added a failure report on a genuine `began: false`.
